targetIssueVerification.title: Constellation filtering in the asynchronous worker path

targetIssueVerification.evidenceQuality: Vitest Unit Test + Playwright Real Browser Execution

targetIssueVerification.title: Cross-mode position contamination
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Layout node positions must be scoped per architecture mode without leaking across mode transitions.
targetIssueVerification.evidenceQuality: Vitest Persistence Suite + Playwright Multi-Mode Transition Verification

targetIssueVerification.title: Shared position inheritance in layout engine
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: computeArchitectureLayoutWithMetadata must not copy or inherit existingPositions from previous layout modes.

targetIssueVerification.title: Legacy flat-position migration ambiguity
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Migration predicate in mergeWithDefaultState must distinguish uninitialized map from intentionally empty map.

targetIssueVerification.title: Project-switch in-memory state isolation
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Switching active project must purge in-memory graph state and re-initialize mode layout maps.
targetIssueVerification.evidenceQuality: Vitest Context Suite + Node CLI Multi-Project Regression

targetIssueVerification.title: Worker versus synchronous fallback parity
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Worker layout engine and synchronous main-thread fallback engine must produce bit-for-bit identical coordinates.
targetIssueVerification.evidenceQuality: Executable CLI Parity Test + Browser Runtime

targetIssueVerification.title: Static/interactive layout switch position authority
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Switching between static and interactive modes must respect position authority policy without unwanted auto-layout.

targetIssueVerification.title: Single-click side effects before double-click handling
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Single-click selection side effects must be debounced to prevent interfering with double-click expansion.

targetIssueVerification.title: Duplicate activation from accessible-list keyboard handling
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard Enter and Space keydown events must not trigger duplicate selection callbacks on list items.

targetIssueVerification.title: Edge deselection incomplete in fallback path
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Deselecting a node or clicking empty canvas must clear selected edge highlights across all layout mode paths.

targetIssueVerification.title: Selection exclusivity & cross-view synchronization
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Selection state must remain synchronized across graph view, accessible node list, and side drawer without state duplication.

targetIssueVerification.title: Workspace lens/surface capability mismatch
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Workspace surfaces must declare capability flags matching supported layout modes.

targetIssueVerification.title: Zoom/pan configuration API contract
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Cytoscape zoom and pan bounds must conform to minZoom (0.1) and maxZoom (3.0) configuration contract.

targetIssueVerification.title: Stale double-tap callback references
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Touch gesture double-tap handlers must capture current state references without stale closures.

targetIssueVerification.title: Accessible graph node list scalability
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Accessible node list must render bounded top-50 items to prevent DOM freezing on 500+ node graphs.

targetIssueVerification.title: Drawer dependency list bounds
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Drawer dependency list must bound initial items and provide Show More expansion for dense components.

targetIssueVerification.title: Accessible names, roles, selected/pressed states
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: All interactive controls must feature ARIA attributes (aria-selected, aria-pressed, aria-label) conforming to WCAG 2.1 AA.

targetIssueVerification.title: Capability-aware overlays & unsupported-mode states
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: FeatureOverlayCanvas must hide feature region rects when active mode does not support feature overlays.

targetIssueVerification.title: Animation-frame/event cleanup & long-session leaks
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: All window event listeners, requestAnimationFrame calls, and timers must be cleared on component unmount.
targetIssueVerification.evidenceQuality: Vitest Suite + Real Playwright Browser Runtime

targetIssueVerification.title: Graph update cost and unnecessary Cytoscape rebuilds
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Updating node positions must re-use existing Cytoscape elements via cy.batch() without tearing down DOM graph.

targetIssueVerification.title: Rules-of-Hooks / conditional render reachability
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: All React Hooks must be called unconditionally at top-level before any early return statements.

targetIssueVerification.title: Stale focus-origin after disable/re-enable
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Re-enabling investigation mode must reset stale focus origin from previous investigation session.

targetIssueVerification.title: Connection / Impact exit traps
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: Users must be able to exit connection or impact mode via Escape key binding or clear close UI button.

targetIssueVerification.title: Effect dependency omissions / stale graph state
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: All useEffect hooks in GraphView.tsx must include complete, accurate dependency arrays.

targetIssueVerification.title: Loading / error / empty-state handling
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: App shell must render loading spinners during dataset fetches and error boundaries on render exceptions.

targetIssueVerification.title: Type safety, depth parsing, loose types
targetIssueVerification.acceptanceCriteria: TypeScript compilation (tsc --noEmit) must pass with zero type errors across explorer/ codebase.
